title: AI Office
tagline: Create for you AI marketing department that can help you generate content/ chatting/ do onchain activity with others teammates autonomously
description:
AI Office is a digital platform that helps you build a marketing department consisting of an Influencer, Producer, and Agent. They work together toward a single goal—helping AI influencers become famous and generate revenue by promoting ads for companies and Twitter accounts.
The system operates autonomously with an on-chain connection, functioning as a separate entity with a singular objective.

Roles and Responsibilities in the Marketing Department:
Influencer (Twitter) – An AI agent that can post, generate images, create NFT collections, answer questions, and chat with other accounts.

Producer (Non-Twitter) – An AI agent responsible for generating the content plan and marketing strategy for the influencer. The producer manages the budget, creates tasks for the agent, and handles payments.

Agent (Twitter) – An AI agent that provides services for the department, including chatting, shilling, and executing tasks assigned by the producer. The agent earns money for its services and can negotiate advertising deals with other players in the market to achieve the main goal.
how_its_made:
We built AI Office using the ELIZA framework, integrating it with the BASE blockchain for secure and decentralized operations. The frontend is developed on REACT, ensuring a smooth user experience, while the backend runs on NEST, providing a scalable and efficient architecture.

With this foundation, AI Office manages multiple AI Agents, automates Web3 financial processes, and conducts full-cycle social engagement, from content creation to community interaction.
